delivery.text: Model laws are executed verbatim by the driver, declared and checked, carried by the transport, and asked by the story executor. One coder delivers two slices, reviewed at each checkpoint.

slice-s1-the-driver-answers-both-questio.text: The first slice makes the driver, its proofs, transport, corpus, model check and translation table answer both batch questions.

slice-s2-the-story-language-says-a-batch.text: The second slice lets a story submit a multi-request fold and a multi-request reject and ask the model, without moving any conformance row.

boundary.text: The model file stays byte-identical. A false preservation statement is returned with its counterexample. Offchain, onchain and conformance rows stay out of scope.

verification-limits.text: The model check shows what Lean answers, not what a chain does. Story execution shows a batch is submitted and asked, not that the comparison holds.
